asset_heavy.reason: Ethylene production facilities in Calvert City and Lake Charles plus a 200-mile ethylene pipeline need heavy ongoing capital.

big_ticket.reason: Ethylene is a commodity chemical bought in frequent, repeat volumes under supply agreements, not large infrequent purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Ethylene feeds polyethylene and PVC for packaging, construction and transportation, so demand falls in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Nearly all ethylene is sold to Westlake Corporation, a large industrial parent, under long-term agreements.

notes: Revenue comes mostly from ethylene sales to the parent under a fee-based ethylene sales agreement; recurring status inferred.

offers_products.reason: Manufactures and supplies ethylene, a chemical building block for polyethylene and PVC.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from selling manufactured ethylene, not work done for customers; pipeline serves its own product.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from ethylene plants and pipeline assets producing a commodity chemical, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ethylene is sold continuously to Westlake under long-term take-or-pay style supply agreements, repeat bulk purchases.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells ethylene only to industrial customers, mainly its parent Westlake; no household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Ethylene is sold to Westlake Corporation and other industrial derivative producers.
